1. I don't have a tool available to execute shell commands or run Python scripts. My available tools are limited to filesystem reads/writes (within `/tmp/mcp-workspace`, `/tmp`, `/app`), a browser, a SQL query tool, and Notion APIs.

Modifying system profile files (e.g., `/etc/profile`, `~/.bashrc`, `~/.profile`) based on contents I've never seen, via a script I never actually wrote with verified logic, would be unsafe even if I had execution capabilities.
